text.aria-label: Title text 'Lead-day 1 is the forecast for the day after the day it is issued. Both versions use the primary (default XGBoost) setting. The fingerprint figure compares shared models with each other. All rows are exploratory. Arms. B0: the baseline with no lag. L1: B0 plus the power at the same hour on the latest whole day before the forecast was issued (two days before the target day for a day-ahead forecast).'

The fingerprint figure compares shared models with each other.
